stem.text: The diagram shows the cell cycle of a mammalian cell.

stem.alt: Circular cell cycle diagram divided into segments labelled S, G2, M and G1, with a leader line labelled cytokinesis.

stem.text: Checkpoints in the cell cycle of mammals prevent the cycle from continuing when mistakes are made or DNA is damaged.
Four of the checkpoints are described.

items: Mitosis is blocked if DNA replication is incomplete.
Anaphase is blocked if the assembly of chromatids on the spindle is unsuccessful.
DNA replication is blocked if DNA is damaged.
DNA replication stops if damage to DNA has not been repaired.
